rules.title: Residential Tenant Protections (Tenants' Right to Know Regulations), San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.requirement: A landlord may not terminate a tenancy without at-fault or no-fault just cause. No-fault grounds (owner or relative occupancy, withdrawal from the market, government orders, demolition or substantial remodel) carry notice, proof, re-rental and relocation-assistance duties. Landlords must give tenants a written notice of protections and the Tenant Protection Guide.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; owner move-in for at least 12 continuous months, occupant must move in within 90 days; remodel requires vacating at least 30 continuous days
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code §§98.0701-98.0705 (Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7)
rules.status_basis: Division in the Municipal Code; amended by O-21647 N.S. on 5-25-2023, effective 6-24-2023, and by O-21769 N.S. on 2-27-2024, effective 3-28-2024.

exempt_if.text: housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome
residential rental property that is alienable separate from the title to any other dwelling unit

exempt_if.name: landlord_not_REIT_corporation_or_corporate_LLC_with_notice
exempt_if.text: landlord is not a REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management, and tenants were given written exemption notice
a property containing two separate dwelling units within a single structure

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: landlord occupies one unit as principal residence at the beginning of the tenancy and continues in occupancy
single-family residence occupied by the landlord as principal place of residence

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: occupied by the landlord as principal residence; rents no more than two bedrooms, two ADUs or two JADUs

exempt_if.name: special_housing_types
exempt_if.text: transient/tourist hotels, short-term occupancy, deed-restricted or subsidised affordable housing (not Section 8), mobilehomes under the Mobilehome Residency Law, care facilities, nonprofit hospitals, religious facilities, transitional housing, dormitories, shared bathroom or kitchen with the landlord

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental tenancies in San Diego unless exempt.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts new construction under 15 years old, certain owner-occupied and separately alienable housing, affordable and subsidised housing, hotels, dormitories, care facilities and mobilehomes under state law.

precedence.text: The rights conferred by this Division are in addition to any existing rights provided to tenants by state or federal law.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
